dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, is that the bag from the department store?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ɪz ðæt ðə ˈbæɡ frəm ðə dɪˈpɑːrtmənt ˌstɔːr?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, but I'm going to return it. It isn't big enough.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, bʌt aɪm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə rɪˈtɜːrn ɪt. ɪt ˈɪzənt ˈbɪɡ ɪˈnʌf.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Really? It looks big enough to me.
dialogue.reading: ˈriːli? ɪt ˈlʊks ˈbɪɡ ɪˈnʌf tə miː.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: My books don't fit in it. And look, there's a hole here.
dialogue.reading: maɪ ˈbʊks ˈdoʊnt ˈfɪt ɪn ɪt. ənd ˈlʊk, ðɛrz ə ˈhoʊl ˈhɪr.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I know. It isn't strong enough for my books.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈnoʊ. ɪt ˈɪzənt ˈstrɔːŋ ɪˈnʌf fər maɪ ˈbʊks.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: My new watch from that store has a scratch on it.
dialogue.reading: maɪ ˈnuː ˈwɑːtʃ frəm ðæt ˈstɔːr ˈhæz ə ˈskrætʃ ɑːn ɪt.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: No, it works, but it isn't good enough for the price.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, ɪt ˈwɜːrks, bʌt ɪt ˈɪzənt ˈɡʊd ɪˈnʌf fər ðə ˈpraɪs.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Let's go back to the store together this afternoon.
dialogue.reading: ˈlɛts ˈɡoʊ ˈbæk tə ðə ˈstɔːr təˈɡɛðər ðɪs ˌæftərˈnuːn.
